_note: GAME-10m stage 3: a test level, not a level to ship. env-01's room (same shell, same start, same exit pad, empty arenas so the page's exit works from the first frame) with two foam-purple growths and one F12 hidden in growth-a. The Ambusher is inert while hidden: it is not drawn, has no colliders, no brain, takes no damage, and is not in the FoamerSystem's lists, so the wave and level counters cannot see it (src/level/ambush.ts). It wakes when the player's feet come within the type's ambush.wakeMetres of growth-a's box (6 m from data/foamers.json), or when growth-a loses any voxel (shoot it from across the room). Waking, it carves a hole, is built at the growth's centre and starts a pounce at the player at once, ignoring the cooldown. growth-b has no ambusher: it is there to show the growth kind on its own, and to be shot at without waking anything. Metres, Y up, -z is north, positions are box centres, sizes are full extents.
